_comment: Source of truth for the es skill registry (ROADMAP 125; format: docs/skill-tagging-spec.md). Edit this file, not content/<course>/indexes/skill-registry.json: scripts/build_skill_registry.py generates those, grammar-titles.json and skill-prereqs.json from it. Adding, removing, merging, splitting or renaming a skill also needs an entry in skills/frozen-es.json (the user's sign-off). "retired" slugs are not skills: they stay only until the read-through retags their exercises.
